blocks.t: Using Riemann Sums to Estimate Areas, Volumes, and Lengths of Curves Visualize and approximate areas and volumes in Part I and Part II: Volumes of Revolution; and Part III: Lengths of Curves.

Modeling a Bungee Cord Jump Collect data (or use data previously collected) to build and refine a model for the force exerted by a jumper’s bungee cord. Use the work-energy theorem to compute the distance fallen for a given jumper and a given length of bungee cord.
